comments.value: Can you clarify the steps/scenario for this bug?  Was this involving a group instance?

@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name} A user requested our group while the Actor had invite permissions. Later, the actor's invite managment permissions were revoked, as they were temporary. Further later, presumably they still had the group request notification, as they were able to deny it
